SYMPTOM: Keyboard extension crashing, slow cold start (5s+), binary 1.9MB
CAUSE: Settings.swift (contains `@MainActor class SettingsStore: ObservableObject` with static singleton — initializes on process launch, uses Combine), WebSocketClient.swift (765 lines, actors, Combine), WebSocketModels.swift, TranscriptionConfig.swift were all compiled into the keyboard target but NEVER USED by it.
FIX: Removed those 4 files from WhisnapKeyboard target via Xcode target membership. Keyboard only needs KeychainManager.swift and Endpoints.swift from the shared code.
RESULT: Binary 1.9MB → 1.0MB. @MainActor static singleton no longer initializes on extension load.
GOTCHA: The keyboard has its OWN KeyboardSettings struct — it doesn't need Settings.swift at all. WebSocketClient.swift is also replaced by inline WebSocket code in KeyboardTranscriptionService.swift.
